hooks.command: payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null) || { while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; echo 'hook: cannot read payload; allowing call.' >&2; exit 0; }; if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -r "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh" ] && command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1 && err=$(mktemp 2>/dev/null); then trap 'rm -f "$err" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; if decision=$(printf '%s' "$payload" 2>/dev/null | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" bash "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh" 2>"$err"); then cat "$err" >&2; [ -z "$decision" ] || printf '%s\n' "$decision"; else echo 'agent-ops: block-destructive.sh failed; allowing call.' >&2; fi; else echo 'agent-ops: block-destructive.sh not found under the git root; allowing call.' >&2; fi; exit 0
